authority: diagnostic: paper only, not investment advice
flags: Oportun raised its full-year 2026 revenue and earnings outlook and lowered its expected credit losses. This is a guidance raise, not a withdrawal.
The company added three senior leaders: Bill Franklin as Chief Financial Officer, Bernardo Martinez as Chief Retail and Sales Officer, and Garrett Hope as Chief Product Officer.
The company repaid $68 million of Corporate Debt as part of balance sheet optimization actions, which the release credits for part of the lower Cost of Debt.
no_value_reason: some filed figures are years older than the latest annual report

business_model.basis: Stated in the 10-Q MD&A overview and the 10-K business section.
business_model.claim: Oportun sells lending products (unsecured and secured personal loans) and an automated savings product called Set & Save.
quotes: We also offer automated savings, through our Set & Save product.

business_model.basis: Stated in the 10-K Item 1 and Item 1A.
business_model.claim: Customers are called members. They are people the company says mainstream financial providers do not serve well, and the company reports 2.8 million existing members.
quotes: Our members are among the millions of hardworking Americans who are not well served by mainstream financial products.

business_model.claim: Unsecured personal loans are fixed-rate installment loans of $300 to $10,000 with terms of 12 to 54 months. As of Sept 30, 2026 the weighted average APR at origination across active loans was 35.5% and the weighted average term was 38 months.
quotes: Our loans do not have prepayment penalties or balloon payments, and range in size from $300 to $10,000 with terms of 12 to 54 months.

business_model.claim: Secured personal loans, backed by an automobile, run from $2,525 to $18,500. As of Sept 30, 2026 their weighted average APR at origination was 33.1%, and they were offered in 8 states.
quotes: Our secured personal loans range in size from $2,525 to $18,500 with terms ranging from 24 to 64 months.

business_model.basis: Figures are from the 10-Q income statement. The 90% statement is in the 10-K risk factors.
business_model.claim: Revenue is mostly loan interest income. In Q3 2026 interest income was 231,436 of total revenue of 246,277 (table in thousands), and the 10-K says over 90% of revenue comes from loan interest.
quotes: We earn over 90% of our revenue from interest payments on the loans we make to our members.

business_model.basis: Stated in the Q3 2026 earnings release.
business_model.claim: The main swing factor in Q3 2026 revenue was originations and the origination fees they generate. Aggregate originations were $572 million, up 12% from $512 million, and Portfolio Yield was 34.4% against 33.0%.
quotes: driven by an increase in origination fee income from the higher aggregate originations

business_model.basis: Figures are from the statements and the 10-K MD&A. The Set & Save accounting is stated in the 10-Q.
business_model.claim: Non-interest income is a small second revenue stream that includes Set & Save and other fees. It was 14,841 in Q3 2026 against 16,348 a year earlier (table in thousands), and 6.6% of FY2025 revenue.
quotes: The funds in these savings accounts are owned by members of our products and are not the assets of the Company.

business_model.basis: Figures are from the 10-Q statement and the earnings release. The spread mechanism is stated in the 10-K.
business_model.claim: Most loans are financed with debt, so interest expense is a major cost that moves with borrowing cost. Interest expense fell to 41,130 in Q3 2026 from 56,620 a year earlier (table in thousands), and Cost of Debt fell to 6.1% from 8.1%.
quotes: Cost of Debt decreased by 193 basis points from the prior year to 6.1% due to ongoing balance sheet optimization actions including the repayment of $68 million in Corporate Debt.

business_model.basis: Balance sheet figures and the 10-K statement are as printed. Leverage is read from those figures plus the release's Debt-to-Equity figure.
business_model.claim: Funding is built on securitized asset-backed borrowings, warehouse facilities and loan sales, which leaves the company highly leveraged. At Sept 30, 2026 asset-backed borrowings at amortized cost were 2,039,004, secured financing was 449,718, and stockholders' equity was 433,439 (table in thousands). The company reports Debt-to-Equity of 6.2x.
quotes: We depend on securitization transactions, warehouse facilities and other forms of debt financing, as well as whole loan and structured loan sales, in order to finance the principal amount of most of the loans we make to our members.

business_model.basis: Balance sheet and income statement figures are as printed. The composition of the line comes from the FY2025 10-K MD&A and is inferred to apply to 2026.
business_model.claim: Loans are carried at fair value, so credit losses and rate and spread changes reduce net revenue through a 'Net decrease in fair value' line. Loans receivable at fair value were 2,795,455 of 3,213,779 total assets (table in thousands), and the line was (78,582) in Q3 2026.
quotes: Increases in the fair value of loans increase Net Revenue.

business_model.claim: Credit performance is a key driver of net revenue. The Annualized Net Charge-Off Rate was 10.6% in Q3 2026 against 11.8% a year earlier, and the 30+ Day Delinquency Rate was 4.1% against 4.7%.
quotes: The Annualized Net Charge-Off Rate was 10.6% for the quarter, a 121-basis-point decrease from 11.8% in the prior-year quarter.

business_model.basis: The 98% and 92% figures are stated in the 10-K. The two-bank-partner statement is in the 10-Q risk factor summary.
business_model.claim: Most loans are originated through bank partners rather than the company's own licences. Pathward originated approximately 98% of aggregate personal loan originations in 2025, up from 92% in 2024. The Q3 2026 10-Q refers to arrangements with two bank partners.
quotes: We currently rely on arrangements with two bank partners to originate a substantial portion of our loans.

business_model.basis: Stated in the 10-Q. The acquisition-cost figures are in the earnings release metrics table.
business_model.claim: Members are reached mainly through the mobile app and website, with phone, 123 retail locations and 460 Lending as a Service partner locations also available as of Sept 30, 2026.
quotes: Consumers are able to become members and access our products through the Oportun Mobile App and the Oportun.com website, which are our primary channels for onboarding and serving members.

business_model.basis: Figures are from the 10-Q income statement. The drivers and guidance are stated in the earnings release.
business_model.claim: Operating costs are mostly technology and facilities, personnel, and sales and marketing. In Q3 2026 total operating expenses were 91,981, of which technology and facilities were 32,150, personnel 26,108 and sales and marketing 21,127 (table in thousands).
quotes: To support the higher originations growth and due to severance costs, management is slightly revising its full-year operating expense expectations upward, from substantially flat year-over-year to a low-single-digit increase.

business_model.claim: The business is seasonal. The fourth quarter is typically the strongest for loan originations and has historically brought a seasonal decline in credit performance.
quotes: Our business is highly seasonal, and the fourth quarter is typically our strongest quarter in terms of loan originations.

business_model.basis: Figures are from the 10-Q income statement. The explanation is stated in the earnings release.
business_model.claim: Q3 2026 profit rose mainly because interest expense fell and revenue grew. Net income was 22,931 against 5,198 a year earlier (table in thousands), on net revenue of 126,565.
quotes: The increased profitability was driven by the decrease in interest expense and increase in total revenue, partially offset by higher tax expense driven by increased pre-tax income.

competitive_position.basis: Stated in the 10-K business section as management's description. Not independently verified.
competitive_position.claim: Oportun targets borrowers with limited credit history and says it scores 100% of applicants with proprietary data, which it presents as a competitive advantage.
quotes: we use billions of proprietary data points to score 100% of our loan applicants and offer our members responsibly designed and affordable credit products that are often otherwise unavailable to them.
Few banks or traditional financial institutions lend to individuals who have limited credit history.

competitive_position.basis: Stated in the 10-Q MD&A. The comparison with the 10-K location counts is inferred from P3.
competitive_position.claim: Oportun has a long lending record and multi-channel reach: it has extended more than $23.3 billion of credit through more than 8.4 million lending products, with 123 retail locations and 460 Lending as a Service partner locations.
quotes: In our 20-year lending history, we have extended more than $23.3 billion in responsible credit through more than 8.4 million lending products.
As of September 30, 2026, our personal lending products are also available over the phone or through our 123 retail locations, and 460 of our Lending as a Service partner locations.

competitive_position.basis: Stated in the 10-K business section and risk factors.

quotes: As of December 31, 2025 and 2024, members with repeat loans comprised 77% and 79%, respectively, of our Owned Principal Balance at End of Period.

competitive_position.basis: Stated in the earnings release. The comparison with the target range is inferred from P1 and P7.

quotes: The Annualized Net Charge-Off Rate was 10.6% for the quarter, a 121-basis-point decrease from 11.8% in the prior-year quarter.

competitive_position.basis: Stated in the income statement and the earnings release.

quotes: Cost of Debt decreased by 193 basis points from the prior year to 6.1% due to ongoing balance sheet optimization actions including the repayment of $68 million in Corporate Debt.

competitive_position.basis: Stated in the income statement and earnings release. The year-to-date comparison is read from F2.
competitive_position.claim: Third-quarter growth resumed: originations were $572 million, up 12% from $512 million, and total revenue was 246,277 (table in thousands) against 238,688 a year earlier.
quotes: Aggregate originations for the third quarter were $572 million, an increase of 12% compared to $512 million in the prior-year quarter.

competitive_position.basis: Stated in the earnings release, 10-K and 10-Q. The mechanism comes from the 10-K strategy text.
competitive_position.claim: Growth is tilted toward lower-risk segments, and secured personal loans are a stated route to better credit, though their geographic reach is still limited.
quotes: Growth was supported by lower-risk segments, with returning unsecured members and secured personal loans increasing by a combined 25%.
Our secured personal loans are currently offered in 8 states, through our partnership with Pathward and we are in the process of expanding into other states.

competitive_position.basis: Read from the metrics table and income statement. The reading as a competitive cost is inferred.
competitive_position.claim: Member acquisition is getting more expensive. Customer Acquisition Cost was $131 in the third quarter against $103 a year earlier, and sales and marketing expense was 21,127 (table in thousands) against 16,502.

competitive_position.basis: Stated in the 10-K risk factors and business section.
competitive_position.claim: Competitors with more capital and resources, including banks, neobanks and other fintech lenders, are a named threat.
quotes: Many of our current or potential competitors have significantly more access to low-cost capital as well as more financial, technical, marketing, and other resources than we do and may be able to devote greater resources to the development, promotion, sale and support of their platforms and distribution channels.

Going forward, however, our competition could include large traditional financial institutions that have more substantial financial resources than we do, and that can leverage established distribution and infrastructure channels.

competitive_position.basis: Stated in the 10-K and 10-Q. The concentration reading is inferred.

quotes: In the years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024, Pathward originated approximately 98% and 92% of aggregate personal loan originations, respectively.
We currently rely on arrangements with two bank partners to originate a substantial portion of our loans.

competitive_position.basis: Stated in the balance sheet, 10-K risk factors and earnings release.

Debt-to-Equity declined to 6.2x at quarter-end from 7.1x at the end of the prior-year quarter.

Events of default or breaches of financial, performance or other covenants, as a result of the underperformance of certain pools of loans underpinning our securitizations or other debt facilities, could reduce or terminate our access to funding from institutional investors.
